Driving

DRIFT ATTACK

Build the slide. Bank the points.

Build the slide. Bank the points.

Unlock: 600 trophies · Drift Attack.

What it does

DRIFT ATTACK scores controlled slides on ordinary laps while lap timing continues.

How to do it

Build a slide with speed and angle, then exit cleanly to BANK it. Link slides to grow COMBO.

Why use it

It gives each track a second kind of record to chase.

Timing

The large active score is at risk until banked. A failed slide loses that slide, but keeps points already banked.

Advanced

LAP is the current total, LAST the previous lap, and BEST the track record. A bigger angle is only useful if you can finish the slide.

Practise it

Try Cliffside. Tutorials give you a guided starting point.
